provenance.rule: The unavailable supplied SHA is not claimed equivalent; conclusions describe the exact current local tree. Discovery does not confer availability.

external_product_provisioning_boundary.may_mint_domain_facts: accepted provisioning membership only, by contract
external_product_provisioning_boundary.may_accept_account_identity: YES: membership binds a claim containing account_id; acceptance is not account genesis

FirstRunBootstrapAuthority.authority_owner: semantic compare-and-consume for initial security only
FirstRunBootstrapAuthority.may_mint_domain_facts: only BootstrapTransitionResult and ConsumedBootstrapAuthority derived from pre-accepted inputs

BootstrapStateRegistry.durable_carrier: protocol alone: no; production DurableFirstRunBootstrapRegistry: yes

M0.11_durable_registry.validator: verified StateStore structure/history and accepted/current bootstrap designation
M0.11_durable_registry.may_accept_account_identity: no; account/device metadata and identity projections are carriers of pre-existing identity

provisioning_claim_contract.closure: The accepted complete claim closes account, device, intended operator, generation, revision, issue/expiry times, challenge and provisioning context; claim_fingerprint_sha256 is the canonical content hash excluding itself.

membership_contract.semantics: Membership and the separately resolved accepted claim must agree exactly. The binding authenticates nothing by public SHA alone and does not state who minted account_id.

trace: Origin/mint owner: not represented in the repository contract; provenance stops before ProvisioningBoundary
FirstRunBootstrapClaim.account_id: supplied by the pre-accepted external provisioning handoff
CoreCurrentBootstrapState.account_id: pre-existing registry state; consume requires exact equality with the claim
PersistentEntityIdentityProjection.entity_id: M0.11 carrier of a pre-existing CryptoHunterAccount identity; never admission proof
account_id_provenance.upstream_proof_requirement: Before M0.3 may support account admission, an independently authenticated, non-caller-mintable, production/test-isolated authority must prove that the exact account_id was minted/assigned before or atomically with admission, bind that ID to the complete accepted claim and authority domain, and provide replay, durable restart provenance, and non-rollbackable freshness.

account_id_reservation_problem.provisioning_requirement: external provisioning proof already binds account_id before bootstrap consumption
account_id_reservation_problem.candidate_id_rule: A minted or reserved candidate acct_<uuidv7> is not a genuine CryptoHunterAccount until account genesis commits.

account_vs_device_ordering.evidence: Canonical vocabulary makes DeviceInstallation a child of CryptoHunterAccount, while M0.3 accepts one claim binding both and initializes device-scoped state. No current contract says that account genesis pre-exists first device provisioning or authorizes a coordinated atomic account+device genesis.

first_device_race.assumption: both cryptographically authentic, fresh, and production-authority accepted
first_device_race.reason: account-genesis serialization semantics are not defined

same_account_first_device_race.precondition: account genesis does not yet exist
same_account_first_device_race.rule: must not create two genesis facts; exact atomicity and idempotency semantics must be frozen first

multi_device_semantics.known: Each later device claim is bound to one exact account_id and device_installation_id; M0.3 scopes consumption per device state.
multi_device_semantics.required_proof: dev_2 must carry independently verified proof resolving existing genuine acct_A plus separate genuine device-provisioning membership; account genesis must be idempotently resolved, never recreated.

requirements.freshness_rollback_protected: M0.11 carrier protection exists for bootstrap state, but independent provisioning membership freshness/rollback anchor is NOT_FOUND

root_candidate_evaluation.additional_authority: A genuine external provisioning issuer/registry remains only a conditional proof source: it must be established independently before account admission or participate in a formally frozen non-circular atomic genesis protocol, AND all intrinsic genesis ordering, serialization, idempotency, and conflict semantics must be frozen.

circularity_analysis.rule: If membership acceptance relies on the genuine account it is offered to create, reject as circular. Current abstract port proves neither direction.

intrinsic_semantic_gaps: first account versus first device ordering

replay.m03_existing: claim fingerprint, generation/revision, challenge, exact current-state designation, and consumed-history fences reject repeat bootstrap consumption
replay.account_admission_gap: No account-genesis journal, global idempotency decision, or duplicate-account resolution consumes this identity. Replaying membership must never mint another account.

expiry.current_contract: FirstRunBootstrapAuthority requires issued_at_utc <= now_utc <= expires_at_utc at consumption.
expiry.post_genesis: UNRESOLVED for account admission. Design reasoning requires expiry to gate admission commit time and not retroactively erase immutable genesis, but M0.3 does not freeze an account-genesis rule.

restart_provenance.m03_durable_evidence: ConsumedBootstrapAuthority plus verified CoreCurrentBootstrapState/immutable history survives restart in DurableFirstRunBootstrapRegistry.
minimum_for_future_account_admission: immutable account genesis identifier and exact account_id
exact provisioning claim and membership evidence reference/content fingerprint
authenticated predecessor/head and non-rollbackable freshness generation

rollback_freshness.bootstrap_carrier: Durable registry reads verified M0.11 snapshots and retains consumption history
rollback_freshness.provisioning_membership: No production durable/authenticated membership registry or independent freshness anchor found

impact_on_current_account_design.reason: M0.3 supplies and binds account_id but does not prove that it mints it, so no competing mint owner was found. This narrow non-conflict does not freeze end-to-end ID ownership, reservation, ordering, provenance, or genesis semantics.

impact_on_workspace.reason: No genuine account root proof or available account authority was established.

next_stage: Do not implement account or workspace authority. Independently supply the missing production provisioning boundary and freeze the intrinsic account-genesis authority model: ID mint/reservation ownership, account/device ordering and atomicity, non-circular establishment, serialization, idempotency, and concurrent-conflict semantics. Upstream availability alone is insufficient.
